notes.text: The frozen text reads שכחה/שכחת; the provenance OCR had שבחת/שיבכת.

The transliterations Shikhacha and Shikhat are provisional readings of unpointed שכחה/שכחת. The provenance alternatives שבחת/שיבכת and the heading/body difference remain unresolved; no target or identity is bound.

The consulted scan of Hyman, volume III, printed p. 1117, reads שבחת. ערך שיבכת, differing from the frozen transcription שכחה. ערך שכחת. The English follows the frozen forms and supplies them in Hebrew; its vocalizations remain provisional. The displayed heading שכחת is the existing catalog label, rather than a new reading of the printed heading. The earlier notes record the state before this scan inspection. No identification of a person, term, or destination entry is made.
